project_identity.name: FoundryAI
project_identity.concept: IDE-inspired engineering control room with dark obsidian surfaces, streaming code telemetry, 5-stage pipeline, 3-pane workspace, live previews, and version controls.

design_archetype.vibe: Command-center precision, high density IDE workspace, low-latency live telemetry

layout_and_spacing.desktop_workspace_layout: Three-pane IDE layout: Left (File Tree / Project Explorer, 240px-280px), Middle (Tabbed Editor with Code Viewer / Live Preview / Plan / Architecture / Review, flexible main), Right (Agent Chat & Execution Log, 340px-380px)
layout_and_spacing.mobile_workspace_layout: Stacked tabbed view (Files | Code & Preview | Agent Chat) with persistent stage status bar

sections: Navigation bar with logo, features, demo link, sign-in CTA
Hero section with dynamic code generation animation & model badges
Autonomous Pipeline Breakdown (Plan, Architecture, Code, Tests, Review)
Supported AI Models Grid (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT 6 Luna, Gemini 3.1 Pro)
Social Proof & Developer Testimonials with dark avatars

auth_pages.clerk_styled_card: Dark obsidian glassmorphism card (`bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl p-8 shadow-2xl`) for Sign-In and Sign-Up flows

elements: Header with 'New Project' primary CTA button and search/filter bar
Status pill badges: Planning (violet), Building (amber), Reviewing (blue), Ready (emerald)
Project cards displaying title, description, AI model badge, stage status bar, last updated timestamp, quick actions
Idea description textarea with prompt suggestions
Model Selector (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT 6 Luna, Gemini 3.1 Pro) with latency/cost tags
Target Stack pills (React, FastAPI, Node, Tailwind, Python, PostgreSQL)
Start Generation CTA button triggering stage transition

pipeline_view.telemetry: Streaming text, pulsing active indicator, execution logs, live timer, token usage counter

workspace_3_pane.left_pane: File Explorer with folder tree, file icons, and file creation button
workspace_3_pane.middle_pane: Tabbed content area (Code Editor with line numbers & syntax highlighting, Live Interactive Preview iframe/component, Architecture Diagram tab, Plan tab, Review tab)
workspace_3_pane.right_pane: Agent Chat with streaming output, model switcher dropdown, action triggers (e.g., 'Run Tests', 'Apply Fix', 'Refactor')
workspace_3_pane.top_bar: Project title, active stage badge, version history trigger, zip download button, bug report button

interactive_tools.bug_report_modal: Severity picker (Low, Medium, High, Critical), stack trace input, 'Apply AI Fix' trigger
interactive_tools.version_history_drawer: Timeline of commits/snapshots with restore button and diff view
interactive_tools.zip_download: Simulated instant archive download with notification toast

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, status pills, stage tabs, and key metrics MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="new-project-button", data-testid="model-picker-select", data-testid="workspace-tab-code", data-testid="agent-chat-input").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: Text on hover must explicitly define text color (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). Dark background contrasts must be at least 4.5:1.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode aesthetic is uniform across all screens: #0B0F17 main background, #111827 card background, #1F2937 borders.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for user feedback (e.g., project creation, fix application, version restoration, zip download).
Ensure every interactive component has explicit data-testid attributes.
Provide demo projects pre-loaded into state so the user can immediately test the 3-pane IDE workspace, pipeline streaming, bug reports, and version history.
